short_description: Supportiv offers anonymous, moderated 24/7 peer support chats that match you with people going through something similar.
long_description: Supportiv offers anonymous, moderated 24/7 peer support chats that match you with people going through something similar. Type what's on your mind and you're placed in a small anonymous chat with peers facing the same thing, with a trained moderator. It's not therapy or crisis counselling. Free through some employers, health plans and organisations, or about $15 a day otherwise. What it includes: 24/7 anonymous chats; Matched by topic; Trained moderators; English, Spanish and French.

faqs.q: Can Supportiv replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Supportiv is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Supportiv is available on the web.
